_comment: Self-description of this BRXRP repo, read by the BRX Editor when the repo is a source (or is being added as one). The name and icon here ARE the repo's identity in the editor: a user adds a link and the editor fetches this, so there is nothing to rename client-side. The icon is a filename at the repo root.
name: Atomic's Official BRXRP Repo
description: First-party resource plugins for BRX Editor, curated and hosted by Atomic.
